changelog:
- Major update to documentation and workflow details.
- Editing style is now flexible: title, description, category, and tags are not fixed and can be set by the agent or via command-line/config.
- No longer filters links; all reposted links are user-supplied and trusted—no auto-scraping, deduplication, or blacklists.
- Explicit, step-by-step instructions for setup, troubleshooting, and upload verification, including cookie management and error handling.
- Enhanced instructions on cover image extraction, batch processing, and proper error diagnosis methodology.
- Clarified all limitations—this tool only processes user-submitted Instagram Reel/Post links with explicit Bilibili repost intention.
